en.headline: HKU sets 2027 non-local medicine fees at HK$590,000
en.dek: The university's admissions pages list higher non-local undergraduate rates, while a survey puts the sector average rise at 17 per cent.
body: The University of Hong Kong has published non-local undergraduate tuition for 2027-28 at up to HK$590,000 a year for medicine and dentistry, according to its admissions pages.

The pages list HK$280,000 a year for non-local students in STEM faculties and schools, and HK$250,000 for non-STEM faculties and schools. The Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery and the Bachelor of Dental Surgery are both set at HK$590,000. Local students eligible for the government-subsidised rate are listed at HK$49,500.

The South China Morning Post reported on Saturday that seven of the eight public universities had published 2027-28 non-local fees, with an average increase of 17 per cent on the current year and rises of up to 26 per cent on general courses. It said the HKU medicine and dentistry figure was a 137 per cent jump, and that the cumulative increase across the sector since 2023-24 was 41 per cent, from a period when the non-local quota was 20 per cent of local places.
The paper said institutions were adjusting fees as the non-local intake expands. It did not report a change to the subsidised local rate in the same survey.

zh.headline: 港大公布2027學年非本地醫科學費59萬
zh.dek: 入學處網頁列出非本地本科新學費，報章調查指八大中七校平均加幅約一成七。
body: 香港大學入學處網頁已公布2027至28學年非本地本科生學費，內外全科醫學士及牙醫學士課程每年59萬港元。
網頁列明，非本地生入讀STEM學院每年28萬港元，非STEM學院每年25萬港元。合資格領取政府資助學費的本地本科生則為每年49,500港元。
《南華早報》星期六報道，八間公立大學中有七間已公布2027至28學年非本地生學費，相對本學年平均上升17%，一般課程加幅最高26%。報道指港大醫科及牙科學費上升137%，而自2023至24學年、非本地學額仍佔本地學額兩成時起計，整體累計加幅為41%。
報道稱院校是在非本地學額擴大下調整收費，同一調查沒有提及本地資助學費同步改變。
